final: WITH rating_prices AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day FROM rating_prices) SELECT AVG(rp.per_day) AS avg_per_day_above_average, AVG(rp.per_day - o.avg_per_day) AS avg_excess FROM rating_prices rp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rp.per_day > o.avg_per_day
